title: QA run · milestone:#36255 (22/22) · 305fe60e · 2026-11-24 · 17 PASS / 4 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Milestone acceptance on main for epic #36255 (all children closed; #34632 D2-A signal ②; the maintainer's 2026-11-24 direction to test on main, not on a release). Filed by the seat from runner `session_01QSeKYkNKNUdaZdAtxeG3vG`'s report (Sonnet orchestrator with Sonnet helpers); the runner made no GitHub write.

## Environment
- Same sha and build as record 1.
- Boot: port 41702, `-d file:/tmp/qa/dash/data.db`, `--no-compile --no-watch`.
- The drive was done by one Sonnet subagent (Playwright, Chromium, 1280×800 zh-CN, and 375 px for D9). I re-derived one of its verdicts independently, the matrix drill's default columns. The other verdicts rest on the subagent's text evidence, and the FAIL on E4 was reproduced twice by the subagent but not by me.
- Substitutions, because the cards name HotCRM:
  - Chart Gallery stands in for 「行业收入分布」, 「收入趋势」 and the KPI tile.
  - Revenue Pulse stands in for the global-filter dashboard.
  - `showcase_hours_by_status` and `showcase_status_priority_matrix` stand in for 「各阶段商机」.
  - Ops Dashboard and Delivery Operations were used for the filter-binding checks.
- Member persona `member1` was minted through admin create-user and change-password.
- The new-report, design-mode and edit saves went into the pair package `com.example.showcase.custom` through ensure-customization.

## Promises (from #36256, #36372, #36373, #36374, #36364)
- D1 点图表任意一块出居中弹窗，不是右侧抽屉
- D2 弹窗打开时背后没有变暗、没有模糊
- D3 工具行用筛选标签写明带来的条件，含全局筛选，可改可去
- D4 默认只显示名称、分组字段、统计字段，「添加列」可加
- D5 弹窗里是标准列表，排序、去标签、加列都生效，没有写请求，关掉再开回默认
- D6 点记录名进整页，「第 N 条，共 M 条」，可上下翻，不出现两层弹出
- D7 「在列表中打开」保留并带条件
- D8 全局筛选改成上季度后，弹窗标签里有时间条件，记录数与图上数字一致
- D9 手机 375：保证所有图表能点、条件标签、默认列
- E1 管理员有「编辑」，普通成员没有
- E2 编辑状态：页头「＋ 添加卡片」「放弃」「保存」「编辑中」，拖动换位，调大小
- E3 点卡片出属性栏，「添加卡片」，可「删除这张卡片」
- E4 不在编辑状态时，不跟顶部筛选变的卡片有标记；属性栏有「跟着页面顶部的筛选变」开关，改动保存后标记随之变
- E5 保存即生效、所有人看到，只有仪表盘定义的写请求，没有发布应用包的请求；「放弃」后与进入前一样
- W1 面板用业务用词，无内部名，标题不变英文
- B1 报表页「编辑」进搭建页，左预览右五项，换分组图立刻变，放弃回原样
- B2 新建：缺什么提示什么，下拉自动打开，选完立刻出数字
- B3 分组选日期字段后图上方出现一排快捷时间和「和上一期对比」，点「3 个月」图只画近三个月
- B4 「计算值」可展开，「查看明细」，「下载」
- B5 保存后普通成员看到新的样子
- N1 设计模式「添加菜单项」里「＋ 新建仪表盘…」「＋ 新建报表…」，取消不留空壳
- C1 图表类型：每种类型都渲染真实图形（`dashboards.chart-type-matrix`）

## Verdict table: promises
- D1 PASS — a `drill-down-dialog`, never a drawer, for bar, column, hbar, line point, area, combo bar, pie, donut, funnel, scatter, treemap, sankey node, KPI tile, table row, pivot cell, report summary row, report chart bar and report matrix cell. Radar is not drillable by design, and sankey links are not clickable.
- D2 PASS — dialog 896×520 at (192,140), which is 70% by 65% centred, radius 12px. No overlay element and no new `backdrop-filter`.
- D3 PASS — chips read 状态：待规划, 优先级：高, 预计工时：不为 null, 开具日期 ≥ 2026-07-01 and Region：EMEA. A chip can be removed, and a click on it opens the condition editor.
- D4 PARTIAL — dashboards and the summary report show the right columns. The matrix report does not: a cell drill shows the chips 状态, 优先级 and 预计工时 but only the 标题 column. I re-derived it independently.
- D5 PASS — sort-desc sends `sort=-title`, add-column adds `priority` to the select, and removing the chip gives 10 records. 0 non-GET requests came from the dialog, and Esc then reopen returns the defaults.
- D6 PASS — clicking a title goes to `/showcase_task/record/ID`, with 「第 3 条，共 10 条」 and 0 dialogs. Next and previous follow the dialog's sort, and Back returns to the dashboard URL.
- D7 PASS — a bar goes to `/showcase_task/data?filter[status]=backlog` (GET `[["status","=","backlog"]]`, 2 records). The hbar and the report row go to `filter[estimate_hours][null]=false&filter[status]=in_progress`.
- D8 PASS — Revenue Pulse 上季度 sets `issued_on` `$gte` 2026-07-01 and `$lte` 2026-09-30. The Sent slice shows 1 record and Paid shows 3, equal to the dataset API.
- D9 PASS — at 375 px all 15 targets open a full-screen sheet with a card list and 「N 条记录」. Conditions fold into one 筛选 chip with a count and list their text on tap. The centred form is not promised on a phone.
- E1 PASS — the admin has `dashboard-edit`, and the member has none (nor a report edit button). A forged member `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/showcase_chart_gallery`, with and without `?package=`, returns 403 `FORBIDDEN` (needs `manage_metadata`), and ensure-customization returns 403.
- E2 PASS — the header reads 编辑中, 添加卡片, 放弃 and 保存. Drag swapped two KPI cards (x 504↔728), resize changed a card from 208×100 to 264×124, and 放弃 left geometry and metadata identical with no writes.
- E3 PASS — the delete button reads 「删除组件」, not 「删除这张卡片」. 添加卡片 adds `widget_1` (19 cards) and selects it, and delete returns 18.
- E4 FAIL — the marker 不跟随「日期范围和区域」筛选 and the 跟着页面顶部的筛选变 switches work, and unchecking persists. Re-checking 时间 and saving does not: the PUT body drops `dateRange`, the publish answers 200, but `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/showcase_revenue_pulse` still returns `dateRange:false` and the box reads unchecked on re-entry. This was reproduced twice by the subagent.
- E5 PASS — save wrote POST ensure-customization (201), PUT `/api/v1/meta/dashboard/showcase_revenue_pulse?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` and POST `.../publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom`. There was no app-package publish. The member's GET shows the new bindings.
- W1 PASS — the widget panel, in zh and en, holds no snake_case, 维度, 度量, 受治理, RLS, 数据集, parenthesised machine name or chart token. It reads 数据来源, 分组 and 指标, hover titles expose internal names, and the report builder keeps its original title. The 添加卡片 picker still shows machine tokens (`bar`, `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `horizontal-bar`) beside the names.
- B1 PASS — 编辑 opens the in-place builder with preview on the left and the five items prefilled. Changing the group re-queries and redraws, bar, donut, table, line and number all draw, 放弃 resets with 0 writes.
- B2 PASS — `/reports/new` shows 「选一个数据来源」 with the select auto-opened and no Generate button. Picking Task Metrics gives 「10 任务数」.
- B3 PARTIAL — date-grouped charts get one `report-date-range` chip (全部时间 … 近 90 天), and 近 90 天 sends `timeDimensions [{dimension:created_at,dateRange:last_90_days}]`. The quick row 近 7 天 / 1 个月 / 3 个月 / 12 个月 / 全部 is not there, and 「和上一期对比」 appears only on the 数字 chart. #36767 states that it is not offered when the x axis is the window's own date dimension.
- B4 PARTIAL — 「计算值」 expands to 状态 | 任务数 (5 rows of 2, 总计 10), matching the 5 bars. There is no labelled 「查看明细」 control (a mark click opens the dialog), and 「下载」 is absent because `ReportExportControl` renders only when `report.exportOptions` is declared.
- B5 PASS — new report via the reports index, `PUT /api/v1/meta/report/qa_priority_split?mode=draft`, then publish. The member sees 4 donut sectors and no edit button, and after an admin edit to bar the member sees 4 bars.
- N1 PARTIAL
  - Dashboard half PASS: 设计布局 → 添加菜单项 → 仪表盘 → 新建仪表盘… → name. Cancel writes nothing, leaves no menu item, and the dashboard list is unchanged at 4. Create writes ensure-customization, PUT and publish of the dashboard, PUT and publish of the app, and lands in 编辑中.
  - Report half absent: the report picker says 「没有可添加的内容」 with no 「＋ 新建报表…」 row. `DesignModeMenu.tsx` says reports list only existing reports (#36692), and new reports are made from 全部报表 → 新建报表.
- C1 PASS — Chart Gallery marks match API truth (5 statuses, 4 priorities, 2 months, 3 accounts). Per family: bar 5, column 4, hbar 5, pie 5, donut 4, funnel 5, radar 1 polygon over 4 axes, line and area 1 path over 2 months, combo 2 bars + 1 line on two y axes (0–8, 0–80), scatter 6, treemap 5, sankey 5 links / 6 nodes, table 3 rows + total, pivot 5×4 + totals, tiles 10 / 47.0 / US$616,000.00. The four scratch single-value synonyms and the compareTo draft were NOT-RUN.

## Verdict table: checklist items used as evidence (not in the title count)
- `dashboards.drill-through-range` rev2 FAIL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[0] PASS, [1] PASS, [2] PASS, [3] PASS, [4] FAIL. Clause [4] says the drill opens in the drawer, and it is a centred dialog.
  - Oct 2 and Nov 8 rows match the API.
- `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` rev1 FAIL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[0] PASS, [1] FAIL on the word 「drawer」 only (the dialog shows 2 records for the 2-record scope), [2] PASS.
  - `drillScopes` is `{task_count:{}, est_hours:{estimate_hours:{$null:false}}, done_count:{status:'done'}}`, with no `done_rate`.
- `dashboards.global-filters-rescope` rev7 PARTIAL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[0]–[5], [7] PASS and [8] label render PASS. Clause [6] (Studio inspector authoring, via the console panel) is PARTIAL, because only the opt-out round-trips (the E4 defect). The `optionsFrom` leg is NOT-RUN.
- `dashboards.chart-type-matrix` rev7 PARTIAL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[0] to [5] PASS. [7] and [8] and the single-value synonyms are NOT-RUN.
- `studio-authoring.report-authoring-options` rev5 NOT-RUN. It is mapped, but the builder legs were driven in B1/B2/B5 only.
- No checklist item covers dashboard edit mode, the report builder, design-mode creation or business wording, so those were driven by hand.

## Reproduction rules
1. **E4 re-enable does not persist** (subagent-reproduced twice).
   - Admin opens `/dashboard/showcase_revenue_pulse`, clicks `[data-testid=dashboard-edit]`, then `[data-testid=dashboard-preview-widget-kpi_new_accounts]`.
   - In `[data-testid=dashboard-edit-panel]`, uncheck the first checkbox (时间 应用), then click `[data-testid=dashboard-edit-save]`.
   - `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/showcase_revenue_pulse` shows `filterBindings {"dateRange":false,"region":"sales_region"}`.
   - Edit again, re-check 应用, save. The PUT body's `filterBindings` is `{"region":"sales_region"}`, the publish returns 200, and the GET still returns `{"dateRange":false,...}`.
   - Expected `dateRange` back to `signed_on`.
   - The overlay in `com.example.showcase.custom` keeps `dateRange:false`, so an author cannot undo the opt-out from the UI. The subagent restored the original by a full-item PUT and publish.
2. **D4 matrix drill** (I re-derived it).
   - Open `/report/showcase_status_priority_matrix`, hover and click `[data-testid=dataset-drill-cell]` nth(2) (待办 / 中).
   - Expected default columns 标题, 状态, 优先级, 预计工时.
   - Actual: `th` is `["标题"]`. The request is `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?top=50&select=id,title,done&filter=["and",["estimate_hours","isnotnull",null],["status","=","todo"],["priority","=","medium"]]`.
   - The summary report row gives 标题, 状态, 预计工时, and the dashboard pivot cell gives 标题, 状态, 优先级.
3. **B3** — open `/reports/new`, pick Task Metrics, open `report-builder-grouping-trigger`, choose Created. Only `report-date-range` appears. `report-compare-previous-switch` appears only after switching the chart to 数字.
4. **N1 report half** — in design mode choose 报表 under `design-menu-add-grp_analytics`. The picker is empty.

## Acceptance reading
The dashboard and report epic holds on main for the work it was promised to deliver.
- **Holds:** drill-through to a centred, label-chipped list dialog from every chart kind (and on phone), edit mode with per-filter binding switches, the builder with new and edit through one page, business wording, and the chart family matrix.
- **Defects:** one real one (re-enabling a filter binding), and the matrix drill dialog's missing columns.
- **Overtaken by rulings:** the period-chip design, the reports index as the creation path, and the dialog replacing the drawer.

Off-clause observations (from the subagent's drive; not extracted):
- Date chips show raw ISO strings (「创建时间：≥ 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z」), while the dialog title shows 2026-10.
- The chip label 「Region：EMEA」 is English and the edit-mode filter bar reads 「Region: 全部」, while view mode reads 区域.
- The add-card default title is the English 「New bar chart」.
- Discarding the edit of a freshly created dashboard leaves the empty dashboard and its menu item, which the dialog states.
- New-report save uses no `?package=` on its PUT and publish, unlike the dashboards.

## Setup time versus test time
- Setup: about 15.5 minutes from the start of install to the second server answering health. The cold tree needed install, `pnpm build` and `pnpm console:build`. I spent roughly another 10 minutes reading the epics, the issues, `RUNNER.md` and the skills and mapping promises to items, overlapping the build.
- Testing: about 45 minutes of hands-on list-page driving, in parallel with the dashboards subagent's roughly 46 minutes. Total wall clock was about 70 minutes.
- The off-clause probes took about 6 minutes.
- Deviations from the brief:
  - I booted one server per epic rather than one per item.
  - Dark mode, and the Studio, `optionsFrom` and single-value-synonym legs, were not run.
  - One subagent was used, not two.
